Strong readable expressive silhouettes, anatomy and layered materials, dark purple-blue outline, tasteful highlights, no generic geometric blob shortcuts. 
RIGHTMOST COLUMN x1152..1535 y512..1023: one BOSS occupying the full384x512 cell: MOUNTAIN TITAN, an ancient giant built of cyclopean stone armor, monumental carved face, violet crystal crown and huge asymmetrical shoulder geodes; imposing, intricate layered armor.
